status: Central three-building architectural study complete; independent input for full-campus assembly
method: Blender 5.2.1 LTS / Cycles 56 samples / native 4000x3200. B06 preceding geometry preserved; B07 and B08 facades rebuilt from fixed school aerial reference, source bodies and roofs retained; six shared fine-leaf prototypes and source-based planting island. No AI images and no external vegetation assets.

verification_method.scope: Compare retained component vertex coordinates, face indices and world matrices to fixed original Blender; assert new feature counts, nondegenerate members, camera inclusion and B06 preceding geometry fingerprint.

limitations: Not surveyed; source epochs and official B07/B08 names unconfirmed.
Window counts, floor heights, facade setbacks, gable sizes, PV partition counts and roof grille heights are interpretations.
Rear and corner facades remain simplified. Tree shapes/species, heights, individual belt-tree positions, water level, steps and cars are illustrative.
Full-campus model and web GLB still use the preceding level of detail; this study is not a completed full-campus GIS.

dependency_refactor.reason: Removed unused full-campus load; verified visual state unchanged
